hints.title: Bitmask Color Accumulation
hints.text: Represent the three primary ring colors as distinct bits in an integer bitmask.

hints.title: Rod Index Pairing
hints.text: Step through the string two characters at a time to parse the color and rod index.

hints.title: Full Mask Condition
hints.text: Rods with a mask of seven contain all three distinct ring colors.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(N) single pass bitmask tracking across rings
complexity.space: O(1) ten fixed rod integer bitmasks
complexity.notes: Assign bit 0 to Red, bit 1 to Green, bit 2 to Blue, and check if mask == 7.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Maintaining sets of strings requires unnecessary heap allocations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Ten 3-bit integers provide constant time updates and verification.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should model colors as bit flags across ten rod indices.
